contract: Deterministic progress merge rules — one shared vector set for BOTH implementations (backend/app/progress_merge.py via pytest and src/lib/progress.ts via the Node-side test qa/merge_test.mjs). Every vector must satisfy merge(a, b) == merge(b, a) == expected AND merge(expected, x) == expected for x in {a, b, expected} (a join-semilattice: conflict retries and offline replays always converge, never oscillate). Payload shapes are pinned by backend/app/progress_schemas.py.

vectors.name: learning_union_and_max
vectors.note: lessons read = union (never un-complete), completed flags OR (never un-complete), quiz bestScore/bestTotal = max per field, fresh paths appear.

vectors.name: learning_empty_side_keeps_progress
vectors.note: A device that never touched a path must not erase it (union identity).

vectors.name: terminal_solved_union_commandsrun_max
vectors.note: solved missions = sorted union (never un-solve), commandsRun counter = max.

vectors.name: terminal_fresh_side_no_regression
vectors.note: Union identity for missions; an empty side cannot zero counters.

vectors.name: flashcards_completes_max_per_deck
vectors.note: Per-deck completed sessions are counts: merge = max per deck (loss-free and monotone).

vectors.name: speeddrill_best_and_plays_max
vectors.note: Personal best and rounds played both merge as max.

vectors.name: streak_best_max_current_from_last_visit
vectors.note: best and totalDays = max; lastDay = the later visit; the merged current is recomputed from that last-visit date (the newest device carries the live chain).

vectors.name: streak_same_day_takes_longer_chain
vectors.note: Both devices visited the same day: the longer current chain wins.

vectors.name: streak_empty_side_seeds
vectors.note: First merge against an empty account adopts the full streak.

vectors.name: terminal_speedrun_bests_max
vectors.note: v2 speedrun fields: best full-run time and run count are counters — max wins, legacy payloads without them stay valid.

vectors.name: terminal_speedrun_optional_kept_when_present
vectors.note: A fresh device keeps the speedrun history, and merge output only carries the fields that exist (omitted when unset).

vectors.name: flashcards_srs_higher_bucket_wins
vectors.note: v2 SRS: the higher-bucket device carries the later review state; deck completes merge independently as max.

vectors.name: flashcards_srs_tie_bucket_later_due
vectors.note: Equal buckets resolve to the later due day (deterministic, idempotent).

vectors.name: streak_freezes_max
vectors.note: v2 freeze tokens are a currency accumulated per device — max wins; merge output omits the field when both sides are 0.
